_comment: Mine Site Task Management — Flow 5: Task Completed
_instructions: Build this flow manually in Power Automate using Document 7 as your guide.

flow.name: MineTasks_Flow5_TaskCompleted
flow.description: Fires when a WorkTasks item is modified. Checks if Status changed to 'Completed'. If yes: creates a CompletionRegister record, posts to Management Teams channel, emails Department Manager, and escalates to Mine Manager if Critical.

trigger.type: SharePoint - When an item is modified

actions.name: GetManagerContact
actions.description: Inside YES branch: retrieves manager email for the task's department

actions.name: CreateCompletionRegisterRecord
actions.description: Creates a permanent audit record of the completed task

actions.name: PostToManagementChannel
actions.message: Task completed notification with department, supervisor, crew, timeline, notes, and issues

actions.name: SendEmailToManager
actions.subject: [TASK COMPLETED] @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']} — @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Department/Value']}
actions.body: Full HTML completion report — see Document 7 Step 7 for complete HTML

actions.name: CheckIfCritical

yesBranch.name: EscalationEmailToMineManager
yesBranch.subject: [CRITICAL TASK COMPLETED] @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']}
yesBranch.body: Critical completion report with red header styling

yesBranch.name: PostToCriticalAlertsChannel
yesBranch.message: Critical task completion summary with issues highlighted

actions.noBranch: No action — non-critical completions do not escalate
